sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that he has been implicated in the mater only for the reason that he was Regional Manager of Sahara India Ltd.
He has not allured or induced the complainant to deposit money in the company.

Learned counsel referring to order dated 21.11.2013 passed by Hon'ble Apex Court in Contempt Petition (C) No.412/2012 submits that Sahara Group o f Companies has been restrained to transfer any movable or immovable property until further orders, therefore, the deposits made by various investors could not be paid.
The applicant cannot be held liable for complying with the direction of Supreme Court.

Learned counsel contends that in pursuance to the direction of Hon'ble Supreme Court vide order dated 29.3.2013 passed in Writ Petition (C) No.191/2022, Rs.23,937 Crores were deposited in Sahara Account out of which Rs.5,000/- Crores have been transferred to the Account of Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies with a direction to disburse the same to depositors.
The complainant and other investors may get their money back as per the directions given by Hon;'ble Supreme Court vide order dated 29.03.2023 (supra).
Complainant may apply on the portal created for the purpose to get back his amount.
Learned counsel further submits that applicant is in custody.
However, custodial interrogation is not required, as the prosecution case is based on documentary evidence.
Investigation as well as trial would take considerably long time.

Charge sheet has been filed in the matter and considering the fact of filing charge sheet, the applicant in other identical matters has already been released on bail by Coordinate Bench of this Court.
Therefore, the applicant may be released on bail.

Per contra, learned counsel for the State ably assisted by learned counsel for the complainant opposes the bail application and submits that applicant being the Regional Manager of Sahara Credit Cooperative Society Ltd., is liable for the acts/misdeed of the company.
The directions given by the Apex Court do not relate to the company wherein the complainant has deposited his hard earned money therefore, applicant may not be released on bail.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the order of Coordinate Bench in MCRC No.19540/2023 dated 11.05.2023.
MCRC No.27379 of 2023 dated 1st July 2023, MCRC No.34642 of 2023 dated 14th August, 2023 and MCRC No.29745 of 2023 dated 11th July, 2023.

Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case but without commenting on merits of the case, regard had been had to the fact that applicants are extended benefit of bail in identical matters by Coordinate Bench of this Court, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.
